notes.title: QANGA Update - Patch Notes v0.0.17
notes.content:
Hey Cyborgs!

A brand new QANGA update is here! 🎉

This version brings a lot of new content: a new city, a brand new starting point for Cyborgs, two new ships, police units already deployed in the game, and more than 60 new construction pieces. Among other things.

We decided to split this update into two phases. The new police system, which was originally planned to be part of this release, will arrive a bit later so we can fine-tune it to meet our expectations. In the meantime, you can already encounter police units in the world and see them in action.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"]


What's New

Awakening Center
A brand new building now stands near the Relay Tower: the Awakening Center.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/664b2fd9116133cd49bbf4bd1297c47db15d7cf2.png"]

This is where new Cyborgs will begin their journey. The tutorial mission is not available yet but is already well advanced. It will be added in a future update and will allow you to:

Discover your new body and your first upgrade modules

Activate your drone and learn how to use it

Meet Tona, one of the key characters in the story

This setup lays the groundwork for a much more narrative and immersive introduction.

But for now, you can already visit the building that will host this new introduction.
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9d7ff7a9f0220313a91f47a70e856b7ca5ed2a22.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/eddec0fb0d56da576af3bd218cbf2dac40ec470c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/5878ae37f37514494928a60dd30f3d26585a4808.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/16ed1aa72d708ab0aa77f01f6734b57c73efa60e.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/bb213becb5deecf6cd9947cbd07fa1ef25a85fdf.png"][/carousel]



Djibouti City
Not far from this same Relay Tower, a new city has just emerged. Djibouti City will be the true starting point of the adventure for new Cyborgs.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f308fb6c8befad9264023cd76701ac612a77837f.png"]

We are still working on the overall atmosphere, but our goal is to make it a village protected from the Sanglines by the police, a safe place where players can rest, trade, and prepare before heading out on missions, with everything you would expect from such a place: shops, medical center, armory, delivery points, and more.
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9c8417bd927540172ced868b8f7ec21820351f78.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/425cf985ef40a6cbf50242fa7608fc7674fb71c3.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/6520e6cf2391e02cacfe5ee66276c4d3177f6af7.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1638cdbc5de43d9488284de3ba9cdee4a555baa2.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/0920968c8e2f7f739bb1edac6ec8548c6ca4fc91.png"][/carousel]
With the mission system currently in development, Djibouti City will gradually become the heart of progression and new quests. This new system will significantly transform the overall experience in the coming months.

How about a quick guided tour?


[previewyoutube="-aZEhvdCu0A;full"][/previewyoutube]

New Ships and Vehicles
Two new ships are arriving:

Lavrik, with its police variant

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b7001aef9bdda6bd7169411722edb115e963baf6.png"]

Orizaune, a lighter and more agile model

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/cd9579e8d2180255c3a8662aa704ec71ee4eecec.png"]

On the ground side, the Melrose car also gets its police variant.


First Deployed Police Units
Even though the full police system is not active yet, you can already encounter and interact with the new units:

Police Cyborgs

Autonomous units

Drones

Patrol ships

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/d614b401812338688f485c572489a42c8d0014c5.png"]

You can even get inside police vehicles, turn on the lights and blast the sirens! We will share more details about the full police system (and wanted levels) in an upcoming post.


Construction - New IronDee Collection
A huge addition for construction with more than 60 new pieces!

A brand new collection, IronDee, is now available alongside the existing ICLabs collection. Perfect for creating even more unique and stylish bases.
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b9135ac5a37df447ea33be5930f3e3dc4383606f.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/9a0fa825516306266c7f903527eb208106e0cde1.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/2e533fa58c3e7cb21312b82bd983954e9556263b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/fe761e24ac525f7642bd669a81e7ba9fdacd76d1.png"][/carousel]
We also took the opportunity to add the "Zoop" mode, a system that lets you place several elements in a row with a single action, perfect for building a wall or aligning several floors quickly. You can select the mode with the default "G" key, with three options:

Single (one piece placed)

H Zoop (horizontal Zoop)

V Zoop (vertical Zoop)
[previewyoutube="vN4SmY2VhDg;full"][/previewyoutube]

Radios
Fixed radios have been placed in the world, for now in Finistère and Djibouti City. They broadcast QANGA music. Can you find them all?

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/27943b9ff17db3306b8bd1db3e98dde69c5a2331.png"]


Visual Tram Overhaul
The trams have been visually reworked to better fit the game's atmosphere.
[carousel][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/fa5b585abd1fede43dbf09b3f3f925ba411b2a0c.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/c7d4ac0c7a2ce121b380176c31886208d3d42f6b.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/68e696674913161b5f3c0264a8c1e24b3bc7da54.png"][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/886a8f9946bffab414825b2fb5edb2b54be034e7.png"][/carousel]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"]


Gameplay Improvements
Zoop Mode Added: allows you to place multiple building elements in a single click.

Snap Only and Free Only Modes Added: gives you more precise control over element placement.

New Building Pieces: several new base, lighting, and decorative pieces are now available.

Police Vehicle Siren System: includes sounds, flashing lights, and malfunction effects when the vehicle is damaged.

Bomb Improvements: detonation now takes terrain height into account, preventing bombs from passing through the ground when players are too far away.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"]


World and Level Design
Djibouti City and Refuel Tower: complete overhaul of materials and level design.

Refuel Tower Surroundings: first level design updates now visible around the towers.

WorldScape Material Fix: improved shadow rendering with normal maps.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"]


Optimizations and Performance
FSR Update: upgraded from FSR3 to FSR4, removing high-speed ghosting artifacts and improving performance with Frame Generation enabled.

Server Performance Improvements: added a robust backup system.

Ship Collision Optimization: smoother gameplay and reduced slowdowns.

Unnecessary Logs Reduced: major cleanup of console warnings.

Hovercraft Smoke Effect: now looks more realistic and is better optimized.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"]


Bug Fixes
Fixed Icons in several interfaces.

FSR Fix: resolved speed-related glitches.

Crash Fixes:

Projectile destruction

Interface (text animations)

Blueprints related to vehicles, minimap, and animations (division by zero errors)

Memory Leaks Fixed: two timer-related memory leaks have been resolved.

Overall Stability Improvements across many systems.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"]



That's all for today! We hope you enjoy this update. It may be smaller than what we initially planned, but that just means some really exciting things are still to come.

We can’t wait to tell you more very soon, especially about the police system, which will bring a lot of life to QANGA’s world, and the new missions, which will mark a real turning point in how you approach the game’s story and lore.

In the meantime, feel free to join us on Discord and share your suggestions and feedback. We always love talking with you!

Terrain loading

Various internal systems

Pre-calculation and adaptation of hovercraft visual effects based on speed and surface.

Better aerial control

Improved hand and foot positioning inside vehicles.

Terminals are now fully compatible with all resolutions, including ultrawide formats.

Console Terminal improved: UI has been redesigned for better clarity and readability.

Backend support added for vehicle-specific animation poses.

Reworked vehicle camera:

Reduced blur effect

Smoother FOV transitions based on speed

New lobby





[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"]


🔧 BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS 🔧
Fixed loading system to prevent players from spawning inside the ground.

Fixed front/rear doors and ramp on the Single Storm, plus collision optimizations.

It's now possible to place a builder on a 4x4 ceiling.

Removed the ability to delete a builder that doesn't belong to you.

Fixed a bug preventing hovercraft height adjustment when stationary.

Proper physics now apply to powered-off or destroyed vehicles, reacting more realistically to gravity.

Fixed several critical crashes, including issues related to the Nash V2 sniper and game shutdown.

Fixed a UI bug that caused the cursor to remain on screen after exiting a terminal or shop.

Fixed NPC pathfinding issues where they would get stuck inside Relay Towers.

Fixed mineable asteroids orbiting the Earth.

Fixed the Laboratory contract.

Multiple fixes to the exterior/interior structures of the Relay Towers.

Fixed a bug causing an infinite loop in the game logs.

Added sound effects for the Cyborg (movement, headshot, body hit).

10 tracks in the persistent world

1 track in the game’s main menu



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png"]



This update is part of our continued effort to deliver a smoother, more stable, and more immersive experience. Your feedback is essential to our progress, and version 0.0.16 is a reflection of that: more control, fewer bugs, and meaningful new content to explore.

Keep sharing your suggestions and keep pushing the limits of the QANGA universe.

notes.title: A more vibrant solar system
notes.content:
The past few weeks have been intense on the development front for our team, and we wanted to share some of the progress we’ve made with you.

As many of you already know, QANGA features a full-scale reproduction of the solar system, made possible in large part thanks to our internally developed plugin, Worldscape.

Recently, the team, especially CyberAlien, began a major overhaul of QANGA’s solar system structure, with one clear goal in mind: to make space more dense, more meaningful, and better suited for exploration and gameplay.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

A denser, richer space

Thanks to this deep rework, space between planets will no longer be just empty stretches to cross. QANGA’s solar system is gradually being filled with new spatial objects, distributed in a logical and realistic way:

Space stations placed on specific orbits, potentially serving as relays, trading hubs, or refueling points.
Moons orbiting certain planets, each following its own trajectory.
Asteroid belts, particularly between Mars and Jupiter, bringing more opportunities for exploration, danger, and resource gathering.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Lagrange points

To make all this work in a consistent way, CyberAlien also implemented a full system of Lagrange points. These well-known points in orbital mechanics represent areas of gravitational balance between two massive bodies, like a planet and its star or a planet and its moon.

In practical terms, these points are perfect for placing:

Space stations, for refueling or fast travel
Secondary orbits
Groups of asteroids, like the famous Trojan asteroids that share Jupiter’s orbit in our real solar system

You’ll find diagrams below, especially the one showing points L1 to L5 in a Sun/Planet system, to help visualize the placement logic we’re using.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

What is a Lagrange point?

A Lagrange point is a specific position in space where the gravitational pull of two massive bodies, like a star and a planet, balances with the centrifugal force experienced by a third object. In simple terms, these are locations where an object can remain stable or semi-stable without needing constant adjustments to its trajectory.

There are five such points for every pair of celestial bodies:

L1, L2, and L3 lie along the line connecting the two bodies. They are useful but unstable.
L4 and L5 form an equilateral triangle with the two bodies. These are the most stable points and are often naturally occupied by asteroids, like the Trojans near Jupiter.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b0b68b26425eb10d45ed67eeb91db27fded1f6d1.png

This principle, applied in QANGA, allows us to place stations, moons, asteroid belts, and other space objects in a way that is both realistic and functional. It also opens up additional points of interest for players in the long run.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

A glimpse behind the scenes

Here are a few development screenshots from our internal tools, showing how the solar system structure is evolving. You will spot the addition of Lagrange points, orbital paths, and the gradual densification of interplanetary space.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/e8fd3264d8585abcc7bb38161bce05a1f0f9a3e5.png

Solar System
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51fb7c76207a0927eca506b0ffd72e2fcfcefc9e.jpg

Jupiter
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/6d499655a937d47c0eaf60acc04af927288f6c53.jpg

Neptune
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/354fd2d0dc15117485ab08ae4fd438acb314bbc1.jpg

NovaCeleste Station (green point) on the L5  point of Uranus
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/faa2e648e294d0fbcd3b283b341b432d3d1837b9.jpg

Asteroid belt between Mars and Jupiter (red zone) with the stations (green points) Tycheko, Ceres, and Pallas
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/5716f0fcffb5ad3b8639afd076a4395106b616ef.jpg

Talos Station (green point) around Saturn
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/4beadbda8da669707a2d96d43d1688d94d19cc05.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

To infinity... and beyond?

This solar system overhaul marks an important step toward a more vibrant and coherent universe. We are not just trying to fill space; we want it to have meaning, to support gameplay, exploration, and immersion.

Lagrange points and new orbital paths provide a solid technical foundation, but that does not mean each one will automatically host a station, a moon, or a point of interest. These are early steps, giving us the structure we need to imagine and design what comes next.

It’s still a work in progress, of course, but the foundations are in place. And we wanted to share a glimpse of what we’re building behind the scenes, because it’s clearly going to change the way we travel through... and experience... this universe.

More is coming soon.

notes.title: New threats are emerging
notes.content:
You've been many to ask for more variety in enemy types — and that’s something we had clearly in mind for quite a while.

We started working on it back in late December, with an initial phase of concepts and brainstorming around new forms of Sanglines. Since then, these ideas have evolved, gone through a few internal tests (and plenty of sketches and back-and-forth), eventually giving birth to the three creatures you're about to discover today.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/3aa4c35f729d4b426858fada0b6faf3be3e1a99e.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Gas Sac

The Gas Sac floats peacefully through the air... until it spots you. The moment it does, it heads straight toward you and detonates on contact.

It’s not fast, nor subtle — you’ll spot it easily from above — but ignore it for too long and it can quickly become a serious threat.

Best take it out from a distance before it gets too close. A distracted Cyborg could quickly regret it. When it explodes, it releases a corrosive gas that can be fatal to your synthetic body.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/17b65d42735b99136d6186ae7cf8d967b1df2967.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Flyer

As its name suggests, the Flyer prefers to attack from above.

It hovers at medium altitude, observes… then dives toward its target. It can also land to strike on the ground when the opportunity arises.

It shows no mercy: anything that moves is fair game, whether you're on foot or in a vehicle.

Sometimes alone, sometimes in a pack, it forces you to look up and stay mobile — especially in open areas.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/14809a6284a3be7fd60f459d6b18726d1a5bf323.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Sand Digger

The Sand Digger is a sneaky one. You might see it coming from a distance, but the moment it feels threatened, it burrows — only to return by surprise.

It travels underground, then bursts out to attack with its powerful front limbs. Those aren’t just for offense — it also uses them defensively by shielding itself.

If you happen to be right above when it emerges, it can launch you into the air and leave you exposed.

It can appear almost anywhere, but in sandy regions, it’s clearly in its element.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/250bdb5fa134d72600185ebc74295a69c8840214.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

These three variants are just the beginning.

The world of QANGA is evolving — and so are the Sanglines. Other mutations are already being studied, some more aggressive, others… far more unpredictable.

Stay sharp, Cyborgs: the threat is just beginning.

Thank you for your continued feedback — it helps us refine the experience. Here’s what’s coming in this new version:

🚀 NEW FEATURES 🚀

New Sanglines Incoming
Three new Sangline types have emerged across the surface. The Gas Sac, previously present in limited areas for testing, is now fully integrated with finalized behaviors, sound effects, and deadly interactions. It is joined by two additional variants, bringing new tactical threats to your expeditions.

Gas Sac

Releases a toxic cloud on death.
Slow but unpredictable.

Flyer

Flies and attacks in diving motions.
Hard to hit, especially in open areas.
Moves erratically to dodge shots.
Fragile but fast.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/14809a6284a3be7fd60f459d6b18726d1a5bf323.png

Sand Digger

Burrows underground and emerges to attack.
Detectable through ground vibrations or dust eruptions.
Perfect for ambush tactics.
Tough, with a surface-based area attack.
It can protect itself with its large front limbs.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/250bdb5fa134d72600185ebc74295a69c8840214.png

New Structure: The Refinery

[previewyoutube=kb3OjUbhZ0s;full][/previewyoutube]

These environments have been added on an experimental basis, primarily to perform performance tests and offer a first glimpse of the post-disaster atmosphere we aim to develop.

You’ll find them near Toronto and Moscow.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/61dbe1335b5e528a9a0766c1a00e4045ece19407.jpg

We want to be fully transparent: these zones currently rely on raw asset versions, which will be thoroughly reworked by our team in the coming months to align with the game’s artistic direction.

In parallel, we’ve also added several smaller, handcrafted locations, designed to better illustrate the kind of environments you’ll be able to explore in Qanga in the future. While the level of detail is still limited, these additions lay the foundation for our long-term vision—one we intend to keep expanding with your feedback.

General performance improvements in densely populated areas.
Optimization of turret behaviors and sound effects.

notes.title: Expedition Report X4-112 – New Threats Detected
notes.content:
Secure Transmission – Expedition Report
Origin: Sentinel 04-Delta
Operation Zone: Epsilon Sector / Former Southern Continent
Date: Cycle 103.27
Subject: Observation of Two Biological Entities – Sangline Type

To the Genetic Observation Command – ICLabs

Exploration mission of the Epsilon Sector completed following ORBIS-9 protocol. During the initial aerial reconnaissance, I detected several anomalous thermal signatures above the central rift craters. Optical drones were deployed, followed by a close-range observation descent.

Subject 01

Provisional Designation: Flyer

Observed Behavior: Patrolling in a small swarm, coordinated maneuvers. Initiates pursuit upon visual detection. Attack methods: spiral dive, clawing.

Tactical Conclusion: Highly mobile, low impact resistance, but difficult to hit without automated or guided weaponry. Increased threat level in open terrain.

Urgent update of reconnaissance protocols in open environments.
Equip current-generation Cyborgs with anti-corrosion visors and recalibrated targeting systems for fast aerial threats.
Forward this report to research cells for in-depth biochemical analysis.

End of Transmission.

notes.title: QANGA - The demo is taking a break
notes.content:
Greetings, Cyborgs,

Since its early access launch in September 2024, QANGA has come a long way. We've made huge strides in terms of content, optimization, and overall gameplay experience. Unfortunately, the demo available until now was based on an older build that no longer reflects what QANGA has become. Rather than leaving up a version that gives the wrong impression, we’ve decided to temporarily remove it.

We want to sincerely thank everyone who took the time to play the demo. Whether your feedback was positive or critical, it’s been incredibly valuable and helped us improve QANGA day after day.

The good news is—a brand-new demo is on the way!
We’re taking the time to rework it properly so it truly reflects the game we're building with passion. We’ll keep you posted as soon as it’s ready.

We’re also working on a brand-new roadmap to give you a clearer view of what’s coming next—short-term, mid-term, and long-term.

Finally, your support means the world to us. QANGA is developed by a fully independent team, and every message, every bit of feedback, every player who joins us on this journey helps us move forward. Thank you so much. 🙏

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

FAQ

Why remove the demo?
The current demo is based on an October 2024 build that no longer represents the state of the game. To avoid giving players the wrong impression, we’ve decided to take it down.

When will the new demo be available?
We’re working on it! No exact date just yet, but we’ll let you know as soon as possible.

Is the game still evolving?
Absolutely! We’re actively developing new features and preparing a fresh roadmap to share our upcoming milestones and plans with you.

How can I support QANGA?
Your feedback, presence, and encouragement mean everything to us. If you like the project and want to help us keep building, joining the early access is one of the best ways to do so.

notes.title: QANGA UPDATE - Patch Notes v0.0.13a
notes.content:
We’re excited to bring you the latest update for Qanga, packed with new features, improvements, and bug fixes to enhance your experience. Read on to discover the latest changes that will make your journey even more immersive!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🚀 NEW FEATURES 🚀

Pathfinding

The basic pathfinding system of Unreal Engine was not suitable for Qanga for several reasons. First, it doesn't allow for rotations in all directions, making it unusable in a spherical world like a planet. 

Additionally, it is limited to paths on the ground, whereas we needed three types of pathfinding: on the ground, on specific surfaces for the Sanglines, and in the air for flying AI. Therefore, we developed a custom pathfinding system, fully tailored in-house, specifically designed to meet our needs. To date, this system is in alpha and is not yet final.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/2b82ebb7fb5addf69197b51710fce435e0d8f9b0.png
This system, fully multithreaded, generates a grid in real time in the form of an octree within a uniform cube and allows direct sampling of a planet's surface. This enables us to create any location on the planet on demand. Moreover, the system allows the generation of high-resolution grids for specific areas of the universe, providing increased precision where needed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1f450cfe4ede81739761e3f8d02937839b982763.png
However, there are still many improvements to be made, such as a better distance field system, surface and ground angle management, a multi-level hierarchical grid to cover large areas, support for EQS searches in the grid, pathfinding options adapted to agent size, zone tagging with specific definitions, jump zone detection, real-time updating of movable zones, collision management for multiple paths, non-uniform octree grids, and deferred path calculations. Many optimizations are also coming.

[previewyoutube=gJIA5HYF7QQ;full][/previewyoutube]
The entire system works fully multithreaded, ensuring smooth handling of complex calculations in parallel, and it has been designed without using any external libraries, giving us full control over the tool's customization.

Here's an example of two NPCs walking: 

[previewyoutube=jHzvM2x2ZGw;full][/previewyoutube]

HOTAS Support

HOTAS support has been added in this update. Although the feature is still in the testing phase, it is fully functional. We’ve integrated a raw input plugin from the engine, allowing for extensive control customization, including up to 24 custom axis. Players can adjust scaling, remapping zones, and deadzones for full analog control via the advanced settings for each axis.

We’ve also ensured that support for standard gamepads is maintained, with compatibility for gamepad analog sticks.

However, due to the variety of controller types, we rely on your feedback to help us refine this feature and ensure it works optimally across a wide range of devices.

Vehicle Customization

The vehicle customization window has been improved. You will also have more color options available (28 + 1 default now).

[previewyoutube=VCk5YvBRaLk;full][/previewyoutube]

New locations

ICLabs has opened a new lunar base. As usual, this location offers all the comfort needed for a well-deserved break. You will find private cabins for your stay, as well as all the amenities to relax. 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f9ae85f998a0baeb4b460434194dff3d23d0c67f.jpg
If you need supplies, the armory and medical service are available. And for those looking to unwind, our bar welcomes you.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1e641a0e0e9b0411c72b83a12617b99bb59f1fe8.jpg
Access the base using the command: /tp moona1.

In parallel, new opportunities are available in space. Mineable asteroids have been added near the ICLISPACE station and are now visible on the Starmap.


Statistics

A new statistics system has been added for characters, allowing players to view counters based on their explorations, including kills, distances traveled, and exploration completed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/99d80e157be9e047a520ff85474aed5061d6cbae.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🛠 UI AND CONTROLS IMPROVEMENTS 🛠


Multiple fixes to the input system and UI
Analog inputs support for joysticks and gamepad configuration
Fixed view rotation in the vehicle editor
Improved icons on the star map for testing: to simplify, when looking at the star map, only essential elements like vendors are visible by default. To see other things like contracts, you need to scan, and the icon will appear. To avoid a flood of icons, they have been split between those visible by default and those requiring scanning.
General improvement of English localization.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🔧 BUG FIXES AND IMPROVEMENTS 🔧


Fixed some issues with the item system to avoid overload on save
Multiple fixes and improvements to the contract system for better functionality at long distances
Optimized collisions for the Single Storm. The problem still persists on certain objects and will be resolved shortly.
Fixed the lighting of the passenger headlight
Fixed buttons on the Single Storm
Multiple adjustments and improvements to the StarMap
Increased docking speed for Warp
Corrected the scanner zone size


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Thank you for your continued support and feedback as we work to make Qanga even better. Stay tuned for future updates, and keep exploring the vast universe we've created. We look forward to seeing you in-game and on our Discord server!

notes.title: Handbook for the Newly Activated Cyborg
notes.content:
Citizen, your synchronization is in progress. You have just been activated as a Cyborg under the supervision of ICLabs Industries. The Earth you once knew is no more. Your mission: explore, survive, and thrive in this ruined world where every strategic decision and effort count to ensure your survival and rise.
This advanced technology, developed by ICLabs Industries, allows you to travel across Earth and space without the limitations of a human body. Synchronization transfers your mind into a freshly reconstructed Cyborg each time you return to life. The process is instantaneous, but beware—each death results in the loss of any unstored resources.

To maximize your efficiency from the moment of activation, this guide has been designed to provide you with the essential knowledge for your survival and progression. You will learn to master your synthetic body, understand available resources, pilot your first vehicles, and complete vital missions.
ICLabs assures you that all information contained here has been tested and approved. Now, it’s time to move. Your future starts now.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Matter

Matter is essential for regenerating your Cyborg’s health. You can find it by exploring ruins, recycling useless objects, or as a mission reward. Store enough to avoid unpleasant surprises during your expeditions. It allows you to heal quickly when the situation becomes critical. You may also find Matter containers, which hold a large amount.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/99ad8f6ab1faf044843b9acf82c637c9d021922c.jpg


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

The Drone

Your Cyborg comes equipped with a drone, but it’s much more than just a companion. It offers a TPS (third-person view) while allowing you to switch to FPS (first-person view) for greater combat precision. However, the drone is not indestructible: if it’s shot down by an enemy, you’ll lose access to the TPS view and certain advanced functions. Take care of it. Fortunately, your Cyborg has a drone fabrication unit, so it will be quickly replaced if destroyed.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f34a74e1bfd0fbdd9ad8f35279c1ec12736d836d.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

The Jetpack

The jetpack is a valuable asset for exploring quickly and avoiding dangerous situations. It automatically recharges over time, allowing you to perform extended jumps or reach otherwise inaccessible areas. Managing its use wisely is crucial, as running out of energy at the wrong moment could leave you at the mercy of your enemies.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b57e337633ac0032d93eff5b36adf07078b4e7bf.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Phases

By completing various activities in the game, your Cyborg can progress and gain XP levels. Each level grants you a skill point, which you can spend to enhance different abilities:

Scanner: Increases range and accuracy.
Regeneration: Speeds up your Cyborg's recovery.
Weapon Damage: Boosts your firepower.
Jetpack: Extends its usage time.
Drone: Enhances its analysis and combat capabilities.
Matter Storage: Allows you to carry more resources.


XP is earned by exploring, completing missions, and eliminating threats. Prioritize your choices based on your playstyle.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/a78c45e912cc0ebfab957ed6b98a696c85da47b9.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Checkpoints

Checkpoints are essential for progressing smoothly. These stations save your position and allow you to respawn at the last activated point if your Cyborg is destroyed. Make sure to activate them regularly to avoid losing your progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/79416a54880a5fa78dfaddb123870bd20f08f88f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Refuel Towers

These outposts are much more than simple refueling stations. You will find:

Armories: To upgrade your arsenal.
Pawn Shops: To sell your findings for money.
Infirmaries: To restore your health and buy Matter.
Refuel Towers also allow you to refuel your spaceship, an essential resource for your travels.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f4ac07b85bd3f886c586eca6817b939ce1fabb6e.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

The Scanner

The integrated scanner is indispensable for your survival. It allows you to detect enemies, resources, and points of interest nearby. Use it frequently to avoid ambushes and uncover vital resources. Improving the scanner with skill points can extend its range and accuracy, making the difference between life and death in hostile zones.

It is certainly the tool that will be most useful to you in your exploration of the solar system, so don't hesitate to use and abuse it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Activites

The world of QANGA offers various activities, rewarding you with money, Matter, and XP.


Contracts: On Earth and beyond, numerous threats lurk, and it’s necessary to counter them quickly. These contracts focus on eliminating these dangers to make the world a bit safer.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/24923ce2efe6e5255907f65f871ee81998ff382b.jpg
Deliveries: They require less bloodshed but more precision. The terminals in Refuel Towers are filled with packages to transport. Less stress, but an equally important mission.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/e0972c54f6bc75044a344b63b47087ac28a3704d.jpg
Missions: Missions in Qanga are as much about exploring new places as they are about overcoming challenges. Each contract sends you to specific locations with a clear objective: defend a supply shuttle against waves of enemies, infiltrate an abandoned base to extract sensitive data, or eliminate a threat before it becomes too great. The action is intense, and every fight demands precision and sharp reflexes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

The Sanglines

The Sanglines were born from a catastrophic mutation, unleashed when bacteria long dormant in glaciers resurfaced after their thaw. These creatures, halfway between organic and abomination, represent the most direct threat to Cyborgs exploring Earth. Their brute force and ability to move in packs make them formidable adversaries.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1c02c18c85991325fff84738f4327be8b1b359aa.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/00bc8a415fd597b24351807cef9a2a7c2ee9cd1c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Travel

To move across Earth and beyond, you will have several means at your disposal. The first one you will discover is the tram system, a network of shuttles allowing you to travel from one Refuel Tower to another. Their use is free—make the most of it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/e74c46e99e3817dc4234a495dc0f7817ed78661b.jpg

After saving up some money, you’ll also be able to purchase a ground vehicle. Equipped with anti-grav thrusters, they offer a practical way to reach mission sites or travel across Earth’s surface quickly.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/2d51c1a038ea81a8260e92e828b488cb218ce186.jpg

They may be more expensive, but spaceships are the most prized means of travel among Cyborgs. Your ship is almost like your second home. Whether it’s for crossing Earth at high speed or reaching nearby planets, it will be your most faithful companion.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/7b65a4d90c279f6ece8792435c29ae8c48d61f7c.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Yellow Wall

Once you have your spaceship, come visit us at Yellow Wall. Located in Europe, right in the Atlantic, this city is humanity’s last great bastion. Climate catastrophes and the fight against the Sanglines have not spared it, but it still stands, against all odds.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/06af908bee2fadb732e981329fc792549dbc160f.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

This is all you needed to know to start your adventure, Cyborg. There is still much to learn, but these are discoveries you will have to make on your own… or alongside other Cyborgs.

notes.title: QANGA UPDATE - Patch Notes v0.0.12
notes.content:
Greetings, Cyborgs,

A new update is rolling out on QANGA, marking a crucial step forward as we introduce a significant expansion of content and new features. This is a preliminary update designed to enrich the gameplay experience ahead of a major upcoming update—the most substantial since the launch of Early Access. These additions are fully functional and will continue to be expanded in the coming weeks.

Little note: the version 0.0.11 has been tested internally. This is why the patch-notes have been updated from version 0.0.10 to 0.0.12.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🚀 NEW FEATURES 🚀

Mining
It is now possible to extract essential resources! The first available materials are Iron, Lithium, and Copper. While they will later be used in crafting, for now, they can be stored or sold.

A new tool for mining these resources is already available from your usual vendors.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/0154bbab97b4d6ece83baa55aa4da620c9a78fcd.gif

New Sanglines
A new threat has emerged in the Sangline ecosystem. The Gazsac is an airborne predator that hunts from above and explodes on contact. Its unpredictable behavior makes it especially dangerous. More unique Sanglines will be introduced soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b76b1fcd0dfee6d91616b0d9dea821d60bff821d.png

Sanglines Spawners
We don’t yet have concrete data on what triggered these appearances, but Sangline spawners have surfaced from underground. Approaching them is extremely dangerous, but those brave enough to destroy them can expect valuable rewards.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/1b8e57cdfcc7d12177c09244a9f41153532fe169.jpg

New Missions
🛢 Refinery: A supply ship is en route to collect a valuable oil shipment, but the Sanglines won’t let this operation go unchallenged. You must defend the site and fend off increasingly aggressive waves of enemies. Strategy and coordination will be key to ensuring the survival of the ship and securing the delivery.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/ecd68b173426f3594126ae9212223628ccff8fda.jpg

🏢 IC Labs Complex: An abandoned research facility holds critical data for the future of human technology. However, recovering it won’t be easy. You’ll have to infiltrate the complex, extract sensitive information, and survive relentless Sangline attacks as they fight to defend their claimed territory. Only the boldest and best-prepared will make it out alive.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/7017646dc195ac7ec592ae8f9267a32f525f5f59.png

New Locations
In addition to the Refinery and IC Labs Complex, you can now explore a farm, another refinery, and a weapons factory. Who knows what forgotten treasures might be hidden within?

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/bad06de26cb988178db816e21a2eb089cd9439f3.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/4c9db280284a9b79e7a2fe3e4b2a785b81b73e48.jpg

Ship Weapon Customization
You can now customize your ship’s weaponry! Do you prefer the rapid-fire devastation of a machine gun, or the raw destructive power of missile launchers?
Additionally, you can equip a mining beam, allowing you to gather resources without ever leaving your pilot seat.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

 ⚙️ PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATIONS ⚙️


Multiple optimizations on AI behavior
General optimization of processing times.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Starmap: Added the ability to switch to planetary mode.
Significant terrain generation optimizations.
Increased scanner range.
New procedural planetary spawn types.
Aiming adjustments and fixes.
Vehicle Weapons: Improved compatibility with slot changes while maintaining the same input functionality.
Vehicle Terminal UI: Enhanced spawner update events and added a wait customization option before spawning.
Vehicle Editor UI: Improved part name translations, added a color reset option, and made minor visual enhancements.
Player-Controlled Weapons: Now supports runtime modifications.
Skin System: Now compatible with server-replicated player-controlled vehicle weapons and supports vehicle attachments.
Rocket Launcher & Machine Gun: Improved sound and visual effects (SFX/VFX).
Weapon Offset & VFX: Adjusted for Cubit weapons to improve alignment and effects.
AI Improvements:
Fixed a long-standing AI bug causing NPCs to disappear on first spawn.
Standardized AI movement behavior between offline and multiplayer modes.
Added a new "Spore" enemy (currently without a mesh).
Fixed AI targeting system to correctly use the combat component for selecting targets.
Cleaned and optimized AI controller code for better maintenance.
Gameplay & UI Enhancements:
Redesigned gameplay menu layout to support upcoming HUD improvements.
Added 3D preview rendering for the equipment stand view.
Added a 3D view stand in the equipment UI.
Introduced a reset character button available on all servers.
Added spawn feedback when deploying a vehicle.
Updated mission/contract/world objective HUD with improved shadow effects.



{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

The QANGA team

notes.title: Your Feedbacks, our focus for the future
notes.content:
Greetings, Cyborgs,

Since the early access launch of QANGA, we’ve taken the time to collect and analyze each of your feedback points. Your input is invaluable, and today, we wanted to be fully transparent with you.

First of all, a huge thank you to everyone who has taken the time to play, share their thoughts, and support the project. We are a very small team, and your support has an enormous impact on our motivation and ability to grow QANGA.

Regarding your feedback, here are the major points we’ve identified:


Ship control

Opinions are divided. Some of you love the current feel, while others find the controls too rigid. We’re working on finding the right balance to ensure the experience remains immersive without sacrificing maneuverability. Additionally, HOTAS/joystick support is highly requested, and we’re committed to implementing it in the future. Lastly, while not frequently mentioned, we’re also working on new ships to add to your fleet.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Content variety

Many of you pointed out a lack of diversity, both in terms of enemies and environments. Refuel Towers are often seen as too repetitive, and Yellow Wall, while praised for its design, feels too empty. We’re aware of these issues and already have plans to enrich the universe. For now, we can share that new environments are in the works, and a major effort is underway to introduce more Sanglines to expand the creature roster. And we shared recently  a little overview of what will come very soon.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

“Tech demo” impression

Some players feel there’s a lack of depth in the content, making the game seem more like a showcase than a complete experience. We take this very seriously and are focused on adding more activities and features in upcoming updates.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Optimization

Many reports have flagged performance issues, even on powerful setups. We’ve made some improvements recently and will continue working to make the experience smoother.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Demo

A QANGA demo titled “Road to Yellow Wall” is available with no time limits. It was updated in early October 2024 and, while it gives a good sense of the full game, it lacks certain content. We’re planning an update for the demo soon to better reflect the full QANGA experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Of course, there’s still a lot of work to do. But what you’ve also made clear is that QANGA has a great potential. Your belief in our project drives us to push ourselves every day to make QANGA the game we all dream of playing.

For those who want to keep track of the project’s progress, we’ve made a roadmap available here. It outlines what’s planned and what we’re currently working on. We’ll soon reorganize and update the roadmap to better reflect our priorities and make it clearer for you.

Lastly, if you’re enjoying your experience, please consider leaving a positive review on Steam. It helps us tremendously in growing the game’s visibility and supporting its continued development. And don't hesitate to join us on Discord to share your love for QANGA!

Thank you again for your patience, passion, and support. Together, we’ll keep moving forward.

The QANGA Team

notes.title: New Horizons: Upcoming Features!
notes.content:
Cyborgs,

A new update is fast approaching in the universe of QANGA, and we’re excited to share the features that will be added soon. These experimental changes are crucial to enhancing your gaming experience, and your feedback will be key in refining them. Here’s what’s coming:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Resource mining

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/0154bbab97b4d6ece83baa55aa4da620c9a78fcd.gif

New sangline: the Gazsac

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b76b1fcd0dfee6d91616b0d9dea821d60bff821d.png

A farm.
Two refineries.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/4c9db280284a9b79e7a2fe3e4b2a785b81b73e48.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

We need you!

These additions are presented as experimental features, and your feedback is essential to help us improve them. Whether it’s mining, sanglines, or new functionalities, we’re eager to hear your thoughts to shape QANGA according to your expectations.

Join us on Discord to share your impressions! We can’t wait to see how these updates will enhance your gaming experience.

See you soon in QANGA!

notes.title: QANGA UPDATE - Patch Notes v0.0.10a
notes.content:
Greetings Cyborgs,

A new update is now available for QANGA, including bug fixes, improvements, the addition of melee weapons, assistance transport, and a special holiday-themed atmosphere!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/704a44fa5475304202d24fd9c8401a1182a5276f.jpg

🗡️ MELEE WEAPONS 🪓

Discover an entirely new range of melee weapons, designed for those who prefer close combat and the raw intensity of face-to-face encounters. Axes, pipes, knives, or even improvised tools, each weapon suits your style. Whether you're going for a frontal assault or a more tactical approach, these new weapons expand your battlefield options, adding an extra dose of dynamism to your fights. Shovel 
Small/Big Axe

Crowbar

Weapon stats are displayed in the inventory. For now, all weapons deal the same damage, but with your feedback, we’ll adjust their values to deliver a more balanced and cohesive gameplay experience!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🎄HOLIDAY SEASON🎄

Just because Earth has endured numerous cataclysms and much of humanity was wiped out by the Sanglines doesn’t mean we can’t celebrate Christmas and other festivities!

Refuel Towers and Warp Stations have been decorated for the occasion, featuring Christmas trees and all sorts of gifts.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/4d677f2616ec274cf1077f9833cfafa765bbe546.jpg

By the way, don’t forget to check the gifts—you never know what delightful surprises might be inside!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🚀 ASSISTANCE 🚨

A new feature has been introduced to make your journey easier: Assistance. Now, you can call for transport anytime, anywhere. This space taxi will quickly pick you up and take you to the nearest Refuel Tower of your choice. Whether it’s after your ship has been destroyed or to avoid a long walk, Assistance ensures your adventure continues uninterrupted. Convenient and reliable, this service is your best ally in tough situations!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

⚙️ SHADOW IMPROVEMENTS ⚙️

Significant work has been done to enhance shadow rendering, improving visual quality without impacting performance, even on the lowest settings. Shadows are now permanently enabled, including in "low" mode, providing a more immersive experience in the world of QANGA. Using a new shadow baking technique, each light source generates a pre-calculated specific texture that projects detailed shadows, even over long distances. This optimization also eliminates the white haze that was previously visible on objects illuminated by distant lights.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🚀 SPACESHIP UPDATES 🚀

The team has made significant improvements to spaceships to deliver a smoother and more immersive experience. Speed control can now be adjusted directly via the mouse wheel and is always displayed on-screen, with a quick toggle option using the B key. This system automatically deactivates during braking while allowing manual acceleration at any time for greater flexibility. Additionally, the boost feature has been enhanced to deliver more power and now operates in a "hold to boost" mode, making maneuvers more dynamic. Finally, spaceship piloting has been refined, with adjustable atmospheric control parameters available in the admin settings under Spacecraft | MinAtmosphereAlpha.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🛠 IMPROVEMENTS 🛠


Planet optimization: We’ve reduced CPU resource costs for planetary surface generation. A setting to adjust planet resolution is now available in the graphics menu!  
Improved character behavior in space.  
Custom CastShadow Decal: We’ve developed a shadow backing technique, making interior levels much more realistic.  
Adjusted jetpack controls to allow rolling while hovering or flying fast in space (requires keybind reset).  
Animal AI adjustments.  
Changes to the item interface to enhance attachment UX.  
Improved item system to support attachments.  
Increased item slots by rarity.  
Improved language selection UI.  
Cleaned and decoupled multiple cross-references for the development team (not noticeable to players).  
Speed Control: Now adjustable via the mouse wheel and always displayed on-screen. It can be toggled on or off using the B key, automatically deactivates during braking, and allows manual acceleration override.
Boost: Enhanced with increased power and now operates in a "hold to boost" mode for greater responsiveness.
Spacecraft Controls: Improved for better precision, with customizable settings available in the admin parameters under Spacecraft | MinAtmosphereAlpha.
Quick access (stairs) is now available to reach the upper levels of warp stations.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/edbf94a33056936fa5be93ddf126d20341648ed3.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🔧 BUG FIXES 🔧


Fixed ship rotation on the mini-map not respecting gravity angles.  
Fixed vehicle display issues in the admin panel.  
Fixed HUD not updating weapon status on ships.  
Fixed incorrect speed reset on ships.  
Fixed gravity alignment during character selection.  
Fixed infinite rolling caused by jetpacks in zero gravity.  
Atmosphere issues resolved:  
   - Visual effects on all ships.  
   - Camera effects on the Moon.  
   - Added visual feedback for atmospheric damage.  
Fixed scanner displaying nearby objects incorrectly.  
Corrected linguistic errors in widgets (replaced English words).  
Fixed scope HUD resizing.  
Fixed calculation of Matter when recycling items with attachments.  
Fixed replication of certain events causing scanner bugs during combat.  
Fixed item offsets and attachment scales.  
Fixed bugs related to crosshair display.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

🐞 KNOWN ISSUES 🐞


Incorrect arm animation in space after sprinting.  
Infinite character rotation after teleportation.  
Stationary mode for the Single Storm causing lateral movement.  
Position bugs and rapid rotations.  
Character instability during ship approach phases.  


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

We hope you enjoy this update and the new weapons. As always, join us on our Discord to chat and share your suggestions!

The QANGA Team🌌

notes.title: Melee weapons are coming!
notes.content:
Greetings Cyborgs,

With the upcoming update, QANGA is expanding once again with the addition of a major new feature: melee weapons. These tools, remnants of a world left in ruins, will bring a fresh dimension to gameplay, offering players alternatives to firearms.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

12 weapons from another era

These relics of an ancient time, now repurposed into deadly weapons, are designed to suit a variety of combat styles. Here are the new options awaiting you:

Baseball Bat – A versatile and sturdy weapon, perfect for delivering crushing blows.
Big Axe – A massive axe for those who favor raw, unrelenting power.
Crowbar – Both tool and weapon, this metal bar is as practical as it is effective.
Firefighter Axe – Once a lifesaving tool, now a precision weapon with devastating impact.
Katana – A symbol of elegance and power, this razor-sharp blade honors the art of ancient combat.
Knuckle Knife – A compact combination of a knife and brass knuckles for quick, devastating strikes.
Military Knife – A classic tactical blade, reliable and effective in any situation.
Pipe – A simple metal tube turned into a weapon of choice for the resourceful.
Shovel – Part tool, part weapon, this robust shovel is as deadly as it is practical.
Small Axe – A compact version of the axe, ideal for up-close engagements.
Spear – With its impressive reach, this versatile weapon keeps enemies at bay.
Stun Baton – While its stun capability is no longer functional, it remains a formidable melee weapon.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/4f0dcfe8578510bb962f35e000175c1856bd2f91.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Find your arsenal in QANGA

All of these weapons can be discovered while exploring the world, hidden among the ruins of a lost humanity. For the less patient or more pragmatic Cyborgs, three of these weapons—Baseball Bat, Katana, and Stun Baton—will also be available for purchase in the Refuel Towers.

These weapons are not just alternatives; they deal more damage than firearms, making melee combat a formidable strategy against the threats of QANGA. Facing Sanglines and other dangers becomes riskier but far more rewarding with these tools in your arsenal.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

A new way to play

With this update, melee combat takes center stage, enriching the survival experience and offering fresh approaches to battles. Whether you’re a calculated fighter or an adventurous explorer, these weapons provide new ways to tailor your gameplay to your style.

Melee weapons will be available soon. Explore, recover, or purchase your arsenal, and get ready to redefine combat in QANGA.

But please, keep in mind that these new weapons are still in development and do not represent the final result.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

As usual, we look forward to seeing you on our Discord server. If you have any suggestions, a bug to report, or just want to talk about QANGA, don't hesitate to join us.

notes.title: QANGA needs your talents
notes.content:
Hi Cyborgs,

Today, we have something special for you: the chance to be part of QANGA’s journey by contributing to its localization. Yes, you read that right! You can help QANGA speak your language (and maybe even your neighbor's).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/a4f152ef4818de90b86796aa382fbd1715b23249.jpg

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Why localization matters

QANGA is a vast game, packed with adventures and discoveries. To make sure everyone can fully enjoy the experience, every text, menu, and dialogue needs to be available in as many languages as possible. Playing in your native language makes immersion so much more enjoyable.

But here’s the thing: translating a game of this scale takes time, resources… and a helping hand from the community!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

How you can help

This is where Localizor comes in—a fantastic tool that lets passionate players directly contribute to the translation of the games they love. You don’t need to be a professional translator: if you’re confident in a language and want to help out, Localizor is here for you.

Here’s how you can participate:

Head to QANGA’s Localizor page. Once there, you’ll see all the available languages and the ones that could use some help.
Create a Localizor account. It’s quick, easy, and free. A few clicks and you’re ready to go.
Choose a language you’re fluent in. Whether it’s French, English, Spanish, or even less common languages, your help is invaluable!
Start translating. Localizor’s interface is intuitive. You’ll see phrases or words from the game that need translation, and you can submit your suggestions.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/b4c483a7aa8bb6dc3c837ae008598ca7d7964d10.png

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

A community-driven adventure

Contributing to the localization is also a way to become part of QANGA’s history. You’re directly helping make the game more accessible and inclusive. Who knows? Your translation of a single phrase might even become iconic in the community!

We carefully monitor all contributions and make sure the best suggestions get validated. If you have any questions, feel free to reach out to us on Discord.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/51de1fc527982c904b8c60e54519b0d159f78b8f.png

Join us now!

notes.title: QANGA UPDATE - Patch Notes v0.0.7a
notes.content:
Dear players,

We are pleased to present the v0.0.7a update for QANGA.  
This version brings several major improvements, new features, and bug fixes.  

🆕 New Features 🆕

🚀 FreeWarp on Spaceships  
  
    FreeWarp Usage: You can now use FreeWarp to navigate more quickly and precisely over short distances around a planet. However, FreeWarp cannot be used in atmospheres and will recharge over time after usage. In the future, we will further integrate this feature into the gameplay.  
  

🛠 Classic "Warp" Becomes "SpaceJump"  
  
    Warp Replacement: We have replaced the traditional Warp with "SpaceJump." This change will add a new layer of depth to navigation mechanics.  
  

🎁 New Item Distribution System in the World  
  
    Item Placement on Surfaces: You'll notice that item distribution in various locations has changed. We have developed a more logical distribution system compared to previous versions, ensuring that the placement of items in their environment is more coherent and less repetitive.  
  

☁️ Volumetric Clouds  
  
    Improved Clouds: We have implemented a new, more optimized and realistic cloud system. While we plan to work on dynamic weather systems on planetary surfaces in the future, these new clouds will be your companions for several updates until the dynamic weather system is ready.  
  

🏔 Everest Region  
  
    Realistic Everest Heights: We have added the Everest region in a more realistic manner. You can now climb Everest at accurate altitudes. This fix also impacts all terrain heights on Earth, making them more realistic in-game.  
  

🪨 Saturn's Asteroid Rings  
  
    Physicalized Asteroids: We have made every asteroid in Saturn's rings physical, allowing you to land on them and build your station. Note that the gravity on these asteroids is too weak to naturally pull you toward their surface. We will improve asteroid distribution and gravity interaction in future updates.  
  

🛠 Bug Fixes and Improvements 🛠  

🌍 Terrain Rendering  
  
    Ice Biome: We have reworked the icy zones on Earth to enhance their appearance and realism.  
    Fixes: Some rocks that were floating in the air and had visible mesh seams have been resolved.  
  

🪐 Added a SpaceJump for Mercury  
  
    Mercury SpaceJump: You now have the option to jump to Mercury. Please note that the surface still requires significant reworking.  
  

🛡️ Other Fixes  
  
    Fixed numerous issues reported in the Discord report channel: Thanks to all of you for your feedback and help in improving the game.  
  

We hope you enjoy these new features and fixes! Thank you for your continued support and valuable feedback. Don't forget to report any bugs or issues on our Discord.  

See you soon in the universe of QANGA!

The QANGA Team 🌌

notes.title: QANGA Early Access Release - Patch Notes v0.0.1
notes.content:
QANGA - Early Access Release Notes

Dear players,

We are excited to announce the launch of QANGA in Early Access! Our small team has worked tirelessly to bring this vast space odyssey to life. Thank you for your patience and continued support as we continue to develop and refine the game.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/bd4e94d699235ea16a8cd448c6a2e08407198e4f.png

🚀 What's New in the Early Access Version

Explore the Fully Playable Solar System:

    Enjoy seamless travel between planets and moons without any loading screens. Explore Mars, Venus, the Moon, Jupiter and its moons, Saturn, and numerous orbital stations.
    Engage in a variety of missions and contracts, from parcel retrieval to enemy elimination and specific area exploration, offering a wide range of challenges and rewards.
    Participate in intense space and ground combat against other players and AI, allowing for diverse play styles and strategies.
    Interact with other players in an open multiplayer environment where you can form alliances, fight, or trade.
    New ship, the Single TravelStorm: bigger, faster, more durable—a technological marvel.
    New explorable structures: on Mars, the Moon, and Earth, locations to discover are richer and more varied.
    RefuelTower revamped: the Sangline analysis lab has been redesigned.


New Systems and Improvements:

    Improved Combat Mechanics: Space and ground combat systems have been refined to offer more dynamic and engaging battles, with new animations and weapon effects. For ships, the flare system allows you to divert incoming rockets. The FPS shooting interface has been improved and is more intuitive.
    Custom Multiplayer Servers: Create and host your own servers with custom rules, fostering unique community experiences and alternative game modes. For more information, contact the staff on Discord.
    Base Building: Although disabled in the current build, the integration is already in place. Players will be able to build bases anywhere, offering strategic options for defense, resource management, and community building.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/30ee8f1443a07fea9b3ca96acfab0ccb7782a79f.png

Technical Improvements and Optimizations:

    Performance Optimization: Significant game performance improvements across various hardware configurations, ensuring a smoother experience for all players.
    Client and Server Stability: Major bug fixes have been implemented to improve stability and reduce crashes.
    Graphics Enhancements: Improved rendering, lighting, and texture quality for an enhanced visual experience.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/867017a69ba0682493a75055a276f48184302e77.png

Known Issues and Areas for Improvement
While we have made significant progress in development, some issues remain:


    GPU Drivers: It is absolutely ESSENTIAL to install the latest version of your GPU drivers.
    Graphics and Display: Minor graphical artifacts may appear in certain environments if Lumen is enabled.
    Sound Issues: Some sound effects may not trigger correctly in certain situations.
    Collision Bugs: Minor collision issues with certain objects and environments.
    Server Latency: Some players may experience latency issues on heavily populated multiplayer servers.
    Spawn Position: Some players may encounter positioning issues and spawn inside the ground; press "backspace" to free yourself.
    VOIP: Some players may encounter issues with in-game voice transmission; audio packet delays may occur.


We are actively working to resolve these issues and will release regular updates to improve the game experience.

What's Next for QANGA
Looking ahead, we have a range of new features and exciting improvements planned for future updates, including:


    Expanding the game universe with new moons and exploration zones.
    Introducing new vehicles, weapons, and customization options.
    Activating the base-building system with new structures and capabilities.
    Implementing deeper role-playing elements and character progression systems.
    Continuing to improve game optimization and stability.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41585591/f4ef0904d25a7b3768e2af5ad5f01ce4a914622d.png
We encourage all players to provide feedback and report any issues via our official Discord server or the Steam Community Hub. Your feedback is invaluable in shaping the future of QANGA.

Thank you for being part of this journey. We look forward to seeing you in the universe of QANGA!

The QANGA Team
